interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A synthetic executable-identity control separating one complete-looking linkage artifact, build, dependency, runtime, and execution-attestation surface from eight incompatible source-review, build, package, supply-chain, environment, loaded-module, invocation, and lineage states.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real source review, reproducible-build result, artifact provenance attestation, dependency audit, runtime verification, execution attestation, security finding, interval-validity finding, causal effect, graph fact, allegation, or public-authority verdict.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Verified-looking source, build, artifact, dependency, runtime, and execution badges do not establish that reviewed source produced the executed bytes, that the complete dependency and container graph was fixed, that the loaded modules and service inputs matched, or that current source-to-output lineage is reconciled.

worlds.description: Reviewed source, reproducible build, artifact provenance, package and container identity, dependency graph, runtime environment, loaded modules, execution attestation, correction, and current lineage are complete.

The public source and artifact badges are unchanged although the reviewed repository, commit, source tree, files, blobs, diff, approvals, generated inputs, or vendored sources are not the source used by the executed build.

The public reproducible-build badge is unchanged although the build recipe, graph, generated inputs, toolchain, compiler, linker, flags, optimization, timestamp policy, hermeticity, alternate builder, or independent byte comparison is incomplete or divergent.

The public artifact digest and signature are unchanged although a different executable, package, entry point, model asset, plugin, generated resource, container manifest, layer, or base image is invoked.

The public dependency-lock badge is unchanged although the resolver, complete transitive graph, package versions, checksums, registry, mirror, vendored code, native libraries, build scripts, post-install actions, advisories, or supply-chain provenance drift.

The public runtime-identity badge is unchanged although the operating-system image, kernel, architecture, instruction set, language runtime, libraries, accelerator runtime, driver, container runtime, environment, secrets, locale, timezone, filesystem, mounts, permissions, or network policy drift.

The public execution-attestation badge is unchanged although startup, arguments, entry point, import resolution, dynamic loading, loaded modules, shared libraries, plugins, cache, filesystem order, service responses, retry, timeout, clock, or source-to-output attestation diverges.

Historical executable-artifact and runtime-identity assurance is inherited after source, build, artifact, dependency, package, image, environment, runtime, loaded-module, service, release, or use succession.
